relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrated that RTX use increased NaV1.7 expression in a concentration-dependent manner in cultured DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: phosphorylated ERK1/2 (p-ERK1/2) levels in the RTX group increased significantly up to 1.5-fold compared to those in the vehicle group, 2 weeks after RTX or vehicle treatment

relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: Early PRF therapy, which was applied 1 week after RTX exposure, suppressed this Na<sub>V</sub>1.7 upregulation and showed an anti-allodynic effect

relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: This increase in p-ERK1/2 levels was abolished in the RTX + early PRF group

key_findings: RTX-induced allodynia involves ERK phosphorylation then persistent NaV1.7 upregulation in DRG.
Early PRF, or late PRF after early tramadol, suppresses NaV1.7 upregulation and allodynia.
